spec_match.rationale: The Field Studio uber composes exactly five named features (its lede's own count — it does NOT claim to cover v152's 26 feature-level suites): CSS Image Animation (5078177326170112), capability elements <camera>/<microphone> (5153829504024576), DSD shadowrootadoptedstylesheets (4790543041298432), unframed IWA display mode (5551475195904000), and speculation-rules moderate viewport heuristics (6240467143491584). Current API evidence keeps milestone listings separate from feature details: the listing places capability elements at v152 Enabled by default, unframed IWA at v152 Enabled by default/stepped rollout, heuristics at v152 Origin trial, DSD adoption at v153 Enabled by default, and image animation at v154 Enabled by default. The feature details remain Proposed for capability elements, DSD adoption, image animation, and heuristics (the latter has no desktop milestone), while unframed is In developer trial with desktop 152; CSSImageAnimation's runtime feature status is 'test' — the uber was built 2026-07-15 when the listing placement differed, and the drift is recorded, not hidden.

interactive.rationale: Every flow exercised live: toolbar animation toggle reports 'image-animation is unavailable; requested running without claiming native control' (no fake control), rules injection produces a real script[type=speculationrules] in head with the exact heuristics fields and the 'insertion is not proof of a prefetch' caveat, and Inspect reports adoptedSheets:0/cameraElement:false/microphoneElement:false/unframed:false with 'the selected manifest mode is a plan; only the media query reports the real window mode'. Startup auto-clicks involve no permissions/pickers/capture/popups and are safe.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede's five-part claim matches exactly what the toolbar/panels deliver, and the corrected 'platform proposals and contracts combined' list is accurate to each behavior (image-animation pause/resume; capability elements as browser-controlled genuine-activation elements; adopted stylesheets as a request, verified unfulfilled here; unframed inspected not faked; real rules block with moderate_viewport_heuristics). The related-demos nav links three sibling concept routes that all resolve 200.

edge_cases.rationale: All five unavailable states are honest: no computed animation control (property doesn't parse, reported as '', and the button says Request rather than Pause/Run when unsupported), zero adopted sheets (attribute unhonored, theme.css route is 200 but no sheet adopted), both capability globals absent, unframed false in a tab (parse is preserved but never presented as detection), and no prefetch inferred from insertion. Nothing simulates permission, hardware, IWA context, the flag, or user mediation.

references.rationale: All five ChromeStatus links were verified against the direct API (ids and names match), while source authority stays explicit: CSS Image Animation is a CSS Working Draft; camera/microphone elements are in an unofficial Media Capture Extensions proposal plus experimental Chromium IDL; adopted stylesheets are proposed by open, unmerged WHATWG HTML PR #12339; unframed is in Manifest Incubations; moderate heuristics has no standards spec in ChromeStatus and is an experimental proposal with no plans to ship as-is; the two asset routes the uber depends on (animated-orbit.svg, theme.css) return 200; sibling concept links resolve 200; the moderate_viewport_heuristics field schema (distance_from_pointer_down [low,high], largest_anchor_threshold, delay) verified against the proposal gist; capability-element interface names verified in Chromium core/html IDL ([Exposed=Window, RuntimeEnabled=CameraAndMicrophoneElements]).

conformance.rationale: New immutable root suite has 10 assertions = 10 rendered rows = 10 reported. Five executable target contracts cover image-animation exposure and computed control, camera/microphone interface exposure, and parse-time adopted stylesheet loading against the uber's theme.css route; all five fail honestly here. Five direct effect/UI contracts requiring runtime gates, hardware, IWA context, mediation, or browser/network observation render BLOCKED. Parent removed the apparent passing speculation-rules injection row because it only inserted and re-parsed its own authored JSON: HTMLScriptElement.supports('speculationrules') proves the host type, not acceptance or effect of unknown moderate_viewport_heuristics fields. Final result: 0 pass / 5 fail / 5 blocked. Because an uber has no umbrella ChromeStatus id, required suite metadata uses the first composed feature's id (CSS Image Animation) as a representative link only; each row cites its actual feature.

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp on HeadlessChrome/150 (2026-07-25): all visible controls exercised at 1280×800 and 390×844 with post-interaction geometry — motion toggle (honest unavailable status), rules insertion (authored JSON shape with all three heuristics fields and delay=500, with the UI explicitly saying insertion is not acceptance/effect/prefetch proof), inspect (all-false facts with plan-vs-window-mode caveat), startup auto-sequence safe, zero console errors and only expected asset requests (all 200), zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: The uber emits showcaseTelemetry.assert events per flow (uber-image-animation with computed value + running flag, uber-rules-inserted with delay, uber-state-honest with facts); telemetry POSTs returned 202 during validation.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements, responsive grid collapses at 760px, native buttons/selects/range with labels, no fake platform chrome.

accessibility.rationale: role=status/aria-live on the status output, labelled controls (range with output, select with visible label), the related-demos nav has an aria-label, and the image has alt text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Matrix pass including post-interaction states: the page scrollWidth equals viewport at 1280×800 and 390×844 after every control (toggle, injection, inspect, select, range); the workspace grid collapses to one column at ≤760px and toolbar buttons go full-width.

When the listings settle (or if the uber should only compose v152-listed features), decide whether to keep the current composition as a cross-milestone studio (labelled as such) or re-scope.
